name: @funcd/example-egress-probe
description: A funcd egress-enforcement example (ADR-0117, F81): a probe function that tries to open an outbound connection to a given URL and reports whether the in-binary egress gateway ALLOWED or REFUSED it — proving default-deny, allow-list permits, and the sni-spoof/forwarder-attestation invariant on real containerd. Authored in TypeScript against @funcd/shim-nodejs; the contract build generates the JSON Schema from FuncInput/FuncOutput, bakes an eval-free validator, and emits probe.mjs + the schema file.
